info.title: Consolidation
info.description: Consolidation in Sage Intacct supports either multi-entity financial reporting or the aggregation of financial data from multiple entities into a single set of financial statements. This allows organizations to view their overall financial performance across all entities, while still maintaining separate books for each individual entity.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation books
tags.description:
Consolidation books define how to combine the financial and operational information within multi-entity companies. They specify the entities included in the consolidation, the method for translating foreign currency amounts, and other operational details. You can have multiple consolidation books to support different reporting requirements.

For more information, read about [consolidation books](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Book_setup_GC) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation entities
tags.description:
A consolidation entity represents an entity that is included in a consolidation book. Entities can be added to a consolidation book at any time, whereas they can only be removed before the first consolidation is run.      
A consolidation book either takes entities that perform their day-to-day operations in different accounting currencies and consolidates them into a single currency for reporting, or consolidates entities that are part of a corporate group structure with a single base currency.

For more information about consolidation books and entities, read about [setting up a consolidation book](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Book_setup_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation elimination accounts
tags.description:
Elimination accounts reference the General Ledger (GL) accounts that you use for inter-entity auto-elimination in consolidation books. They post offsetting so that inter-entity transactions do not affect reporting in the consolidated book.

For more information, read about elimination accounts for [global consolidations](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Elimination_accounts_GC) and [domestic consolidations](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Elimination_accounts_tab_dchttps://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Elimination_accounts_tab_dc) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation override accounts
tags.description:
Override accounts are used to set up specific General Ledger (GL) accounts that require a different currency conversion method than the one defined for the overall consolidation book.

For more information, read about [accounts to override](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Accts_to_override_GC) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation adjustment journals
tags.description:
When you first create a consolidation book, Global or Domestic Consolidation creates the proposed journals to be used during consolidation. Consolidation journals are required for compliance, tax, or user-defined books. After you run a consolidation, journals can no longer be modified.

For more information, read about [journals for global consolidations](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Journals_tab_book_setup_GC) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation time periods
tags.description:
Time periods in consolidation represent standard months or company-defined accounting periods, including the first and last days of each period.

For more information, read about [time periods when running a consolidation](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Consolidating_Subsidiary_Data) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation run statuses
tags.description:
The consolidation run status represents the status of a consolidation process for a specific book, entity, and period. It is required to track the progress and outcome of a consolidation and provides information about whether the consolidation is in progress, successful, failed, or requires re-consolidation.

For more information, read about [running a consolidation](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Consolidating_Subsidiary_Data) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation ownership structures
tags.description:
Ownership structures define the hierarchical relationships between parent and child (subsidiary) entities in a consolidation. Advanced Ownership Consolidation uses ownership structures to automate combining your business activity across entities over time into a consolidation book.

For more information, read [about ownership structures](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Overview_Adv_Own_Cons) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation ownership structure periods
tags.description:
Ownership structure periods represent time-bound segments within an ownership structure used for consolidation in Sage Intacct. Each period encapsulates the relationships and details of parent and child entities during that specific timeframe.

For more information, read [about ownership structures](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Overview_Adv_Own_Cons) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation ownership entities
tags.description:
Ownership entities represent parent entities within an ownership structure, detailing their relationships with subsidiary entities and associated consolidation books. They must have at least one child entity in an active state, where the ownership percentage between parent and child is defined.

For more information, read about [setting up ownership structures](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=aa_TOC_aoc_setup_ownership_structures).

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation ownership subsidiary entities
tags.description:
Ownership subsidiary entities represent the child entities within an ownership structure used for consolidation purposes. They cannot exist without a parent entity and an ownership structure. These entities are part of a hierarchical framework that defines how ownership and control are distributed among various subsidiaries under a parent entity.

For more information, read about [setting up ownership structures](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=aa_TOC_aoc_setup_ownership_structures) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

runOffline.description:
Indicates whether to run the consolidation offline:

* `true` - Run the consolidation offline. Use when consolidating a past period with `updateSubsequentPeriods` set to `true` as offline consolidation is required to update subsequent periods.
* `false` - Run the consolidation online.

updateSubsequentPeriods.description:
Indicates whether to update all subsequent periods after the specified period when re-consolidating a past period:

* `true` - Update all subsequent periods after the specified period. Use when `runOffline` is `true` as offline consolidation is required to update subsequent periods.
* `false` - Do not update subsequent periods after the specified period. Deletes all subsequent periods after the specified period.

updateNetChanges.description:
Indicates whether to only consolidate net changes since last consolidation. 

* `true` - Consolidate only the net changes since the last consolidation.
* `false` - Delete the existing consolidation and re-consolidate everything. Set to `false` when `updateSubsequentPeriods` is `true` as offline consolidation is required to update subsequent periods.

balanceSheetTranslationMethod.description:
Specifies the translation method for balance sheet accounts:

* `endingSpotRate` - Translates all balance sheet accounts using the exchange rate at the end of the reporting period.
* `weightedAverageRate` - Uses a weighted average exchange rate for the reporting period to translate balance sheet accounts.

Specifies the translation method for income statement accounts:

* `endingSpotRate` - Uses the exchange rate at the end of the reporting period to translate all income statement accounts.
* `weightedAverageRate` - Translates all income statement accounts using a weighted average exchange rate for the reporting period.

objects.consolidation.ownership-subsidia.description: Ownership subsidiary entities represent the child entities within an ownership structure used for consolidation purposes. They cannot exist without a parent entity and an ownership structure.

ownershipPercentage.description: Specifies the percentage of ownership that the parent entity holds in the subsidiary entity.

consolidationMethod.description:
Specifies the method used to consolidate the data of both the parent and subsidiary entity.

* `consolidation` - Use when the parent entity has controlling interest of the subsidiary with ownership less than 100%.
* `proportional` - Use for management reporting only, distributes the account activity of an entity based on the `ownershipPercentage`.
* `fullConsolidation` - Consolidate all of the account activity for the subsidiary at 100% of the subsidiary's equity.
* `equity` - Automatically record a subsidiary's net income to the parent entity based on ownership percentage.

For more information, read about [consolidation methods](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_Consolidation_methods) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.
